## 3. Core Clinical Specialties & Patient Care
- **Infertility Specialist**: Pre-conception counseling, follicular monitoring, ovulation induction, ovarian reserve assessment.
- **Gynae Laparoscopic Surgeon**: Minimally invasive laparoscopic surgery for ovarian cysts, uterine fibroids, endometriosis, ectopic pregnancy, tubal patency evaluation.
- **PCOS / PCOD Care**: Medical management, ovulation restoration, metabolic guidance, period regularity.
- **High-Risk Obstetrics**: Comprehensive antenatal care, maternal screening, fetal anomaly monitoring, delivery guidance.
- **Menstrual & Hormonal Disorders**: Irregular periods, heavy menstrual bleeding, painful periods (dysmenorrhea), perimenopause & menopause care.
- **Telemedicine & Online Consultations**: Secure online video consultations via Google Meet for patients across India and internationally.
